notes.title: Read Before buying
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207647/48097e3d680be5d406789a19cd2d05c1b58be4fc.png[/img]

Please, note that the Demo version and the paid version are the same build, we made it because of our college that wanted our project playable until december, so we had less than 4 months to create this game (and it's our very first project). If you want just play the game, download only the Demo version, but if you want to support us, consider buying. We'll make a lot of updates during 2025 and launch the full game.

notes.title: Demo
notes.content:
Due to our used Engine, we are having several problems in the development of the project. Because of this, we will make a demo of the game available until the end of November. It will feature the first playable minigame, interactions with objects that will make up the game's story and "paranormal" interactions with the character.
I appreciate your understanding.

In a few months we will change our Engine and release the final version of the game when time is in our favor. Thanks!
